ED registers money laundering case against Punjab CM's OSD

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has registered a money laundering case against Rajbir Singh Ghuman, Officer on Special Duty (OSD) to the Punjab Chief Minister. This action follows a Supreme Court order and is part of a broader corruption probe. The ED's case specifically concerns allegations of money laundering.
